name: Yukimi Shian
source:
A popular streamer who belongs to Team Revo.
One of the team’s original members.
Her looks and sharp dancing have earned her many fans her own age.

She’s serious and has a strong sense of responsibility. The dependable type.
She’s a perfectionist who hates being bad at anything. She’s highly competitive.
She also tends to be quite masochistic.

She is involved in activities while balancing her studies, and at the academy she belongs to a dance club.
Her dancing skills are top-notch.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1210593/]Getchu[/url]]
